value.rationale: The minimum-order cubic cospectral pair is a canonical finite benchmark. Exact majority dynamics on the graphs differs in recurrent orbit counts, relaxation clocks and even reverses the relation between the number of fixed points and total fixed-basin size, demonstrating natural nonlinear information not encoded by their common spectrum. The finding adds independently checkable exact invariants, beyond restating Godsil–McKay switching.
